integrity: The proof is symbolic and characteristic-free for fields with separable quadratic extensions; finite-field computations are supplementary checks rather than proof. Search evidence is not represented as exhaustive novelty certification.
limitations: Settles only \(n=2\); no claim for \(n\geq3\). A residual risk remains that an equivalent small-dimensional observation exists in older literature under different terminology.
title: The dimension-two finite-field case of the nilpotent-free duality conjecture
